title: Ranking: two columns of five hairline rows, each a mono number, a sans name, an inline bar (an ivory box with a 1 ink border and a green fill) and a mono value
use: A sector or region ranking. top, spread and seed make a descending series; the bar and the value text come from the same number, and the rows are already in rank order (name_1 is the first).

theme.note: light (ivory #FAF9F5) or dark (#141413) ground; tile names and the tooltip keep their fixed inks

convention.note: intl (default, the measured lineage): green heat scale, rising green, falling coral; cn (红涨绿跌, Chinese markets): red heat scale from light to deep, rising red, falling green; the bars' four classes follow it

spread.note: how far the last row falls below the first

max.note: the value at the end of a bar

lede.default: 10 个板块的热点指数，1.0 为按成交占比的预期水平。示例数据。

value_1.note: derived from --param top, spread and seed

value_8.note: derived from --param top, spread and seed

value_10.note: derived from --param top, spread and seed

note.default: 示例数据 · 指数大于 1 表示高于预期 · 条形按最大值缩放

relations: Rows 70 units high with a 1 hairline under each; a mono 16 number, a sans 21 name at +52, a 190 x 22 bar at +330 and a mono 21 value right-aligned at 640; two columns 128 apart.
The bar's fill is the scale class of its rank group (rows 1-3 leading, 4-5 upper middle, 6-8 lower middle, 9-10 emerging); the box is ivory with a 1 ink border.
decoration: The row hairlines, the bar boxes and fills are decoration; the row numbers are real text.

provenance.corpus: market hotspot index explorer kit (examples/index-explorer-kit): our own original data page in the index-explorer grammar; every number is generated in the page and marked as sample data
provenance.experiment: styles/index-explorer/style.json provenance (two public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped)
provenance.method: The data page's 'in view' list re-set as two columns of five rows with inline bars.
measured: Row 23 px high, bottom rule #D1CFC5, mono 13 rank #5E5D59, sans 14 name, mono 14 value; the bar box 71 x 16 on the ground with a 1 px ink border and a green fill.
Template: value and bar share one parameter set; checked at both sizes, light and dark.
